title: Frequently Asked Questions
snippet:
#### Is the Podio API free to use?
The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts. Both have full access to the API and the same base rate Limit A and Limit B apply. There is no extra charge for using the API as long as the usage is within these base rate limits. Paid accounts have an additional capability of upgrading to higher API rate limits by purchasing an API Add-on.

If your API integration requires a higher rate limit, you can request your contract owner to purchase an API Add-on for the relevant API key.

title: Podio Pricing in 2026: Plans, Limits and What Is Not Included
snippet:
The paid plans cost $14 to $24 per user per month, less if you pay yearly, and the Free plan stops at 5 users and 100 items.

| Plan | Per month | Per year | Includes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | $0 | Up to 5 users and 100 items per organization, unlimited workspaces and apps, webforms, 1,000 API calls per hour |
| Plus | $14 | $134.40 | Unlimited items, external clients and light users, read-only access, simple workflows, SOC 2 compliance |
| Premium | $24 | $230.40 | Everything in Plus, advanced workflow automation with 25,000 actions a month, visual reports, email integrations, PDF generation, date and time triggers, ShareFile and e-signature integrations |

Yes, for small teams: the Free plan covers up to 5 users, but only 100 items per organization, so most teams outgrow it quickly. Free organizations can try Premium for 30 days.
## What do the add-ons cost?
Paid plans can add capacity, billed with the subscription. Starting prices:
| Add-on | Per month | Per year | Capacity |
|---|---|---|---|
| API | $29 | $276 | 2,500 to 50,000 calls per hour |
| Automation | $49 | $468 | 100,000 to 5,000,000 actions a month |
